newsitem.title: USA: American Disposal expands in Rhode Island, Ohio.
newsitem.headline: American Disposal expands in Rhode Island, Ohio.

text.p: American Disposal Services Inc, a regional non-hazardous solid waste services company, said it has completed the purchase of Liberty Disposal Inc, in Johnston, R.I. and Christiansen's Inc in Sandusky, Ohio, which together generated over $7.5 million in annual revenues in 1996.
Terms of the transactions were not disclosed.
Liberty is a waste hauling and recycling business and was the largest remaining privately-owned waste collection company in Rhode Island.
Christiansen's has been providing residential and commercial collection service to customers in Sandusky and surrounding Erie County.
